job: fg174s scalar gated_delta_net.cu port (EXP168 worker, ownership gdn-scalar)
packet_args: arg2: dst ggml_tensor* (GGML_OP_GATED_DELTA_NET node; src[0..5] = q,k,v,g,beta,state)
arg3: fused-cache data pointer as i64 (must be 0 when mode0, non-zero when mode1)
arg4: fused-cache slot_stride in float elements (0 when K==1; unchecked raw pointer, cache span is bridge/parent-owned like native)

iv.6: K (op_params[0], sign-extended u64; only read when keep_rs)

float fg174s_scale(int64_t sv)  // exactly 1.0f/sqrtf((float)sv), no other math

void fg174s_launch(int64_t packet)  // read plan iv8..iv12; launch generated scalar kernel wrapper fg174s_kernel<<<grid,block,0,ctx.stream()>>>(plan) which calls device fn gdn(p,bidx,bidy,bidz,tidx,tidy)
device_externs: uint64_t fg174s_dget(int64_t p,int64_t k,int64_t i) // device plan projection (same layout as fg174s_hget)

device_entry: fn gdn(p:i64,bidx:i32,bidy:i32,bidz:i32,tidx:i32,tidy:i32) — grid=(iv8,iv9,iv10), block=(iv11,iv12,1); parent maps blockIdx/threadIdx; __launch_bounds__ stays on the parent wrapper
route: host validates everything first (native assert order), fills the whole plan, then: if iv17(eligible) and fg174m_launch(packet)==true return; else fg174s_launch(packet). fg174m_launch is the ONLY declared external dispatch effect: the parent-owned fg174m_ port must rebuild ggml_cuda_gdn_mma_args from this plan exactly as ggml_cuda_gdn_mma_args_from_tensor (q,k,v,g,beta,state data = ptrs[0..5], dst=ptrs[6], state_out=ptrs[7], H=iv1, H_k=iv18, n_tokens=iv2, n_seqs=iv3, rq3=iv5, sq1..3=strides[0][1..3], sv1..3=strides[2][1..3], sb1..3=strides[4][1..3], scale=fv0, eligible=iv17) and run its own select/init/launch; returns true only if it launched. Native MMA ignores snapshot slots when it takes over; that behavior is preserved unchanged.
eligibility: g.ne[0]==1 && K < v.ne[2] && S_v==128 && q.ne[0]==128 (verbatim native predicate; evaluated in Goose)
sv_support: native scalar switch instantiates S_v in {16,32,64,128} only; any other S_v (including 256) is GGML_ABORT("fatal error") in native and fail(20) here — there is no native S_v=256 kernel to port. No q/k normalization exists in the scalar source, so none is ported.

failure_codes.3: packet/args (null ctx/dst, bad mode, cache-data mismatch)
failure_codes.5: tensor not F32 / null data / nb0!=4
failure_codes.17: dst span < attention + written state slots (plain path)
failure_codes.18: strided input span coverage (q/k/v/g/beta) or span internal
failure_codes.21: device-property effect out of domain (warp_size not 32/64, nsm<=0)

numerics: state shard loads (i=r*lanes_per_col+lane_in_col), transposed-state convention, per-token kv/delta/attn formulas, expf placement (KDA recomputes expf(g_t[i]) in both loops exactly like native), butterfly shuffle offsets lpc/2..1 with width=lpc, attn_col*scale with scale=1.0f/sqrtf((float)S_v), attn advance by S_v*H per token, snapshot slot = n_tokens-1-t gated to [0,K), final slot-0 write when !keep_rs — all replicate gated_delta_net.cu expression-for-expression; no fma/rsqrt substitutions, no fastmath, no extra accumulation reordering.
no_invented_abi: only actual ggml fields are read via ti keys above (src/data/type/ne/nb/op_params/ggml_nbytes); dst layout is used exactly as the native kernel hardcodes it and is guarded by the checked ggml_nbytes span instead of assuming node shapes
remaining_original_dependency: fg174m_launch (parent MMA port) plus three query-only effects backed by original host state: fg174s_warp_size/fg174s_nsm (ggml_cuda_info) and fg174s_scale (1.0f/sqrtf); fg174s_sync wraps ggml_cuda_pdl_sync. No original C++ arithmetic is called on the default scalar path; build/link/GPU gates and the cache owner-side span are parent responsibilities.

files.device.goose: device recurrence (all entries retained in fn main, never run by parent)
